name: SF Infinite Item Use
description: Prevents item-use consumption with a build-profile-verified client patch. The effect applies globally to the patched game operation.

changelog: Documents global patch scope and reports activation and restoration failures consistently.

sections.title: Infinite Item Use
sections.description: The native patch applies to the matched item-use operation for all items. Per-item exclusions and custom consumption amounts are not supported by this build-profile operation.
